verdicts.reason: A buries the RSVP CTA in a 2x2 pill grid at the bottom, where it is the same size as the tag pills. It also moves the date above the subhead and the 'Solstice presents' eyebrow below the URL. The enlarged missing-asset placeholder sits mid-canvas with its text cut off. B keeps RSVP as a distinct full-width button right after the copy, so its hierarchy and reading order are better. But its headline is undersized and the date competes with it, the top text block is cramped, and the logo is shoved to the right corner instead of centred. Its tag pills are inflated to CTA-sized buttons stacked vertically, and the cut-off placeholder is enlarged at the bottom.
